status: Working design choices aligned with verified official Arial and approximately 6–8 pt regular-text guidance; panel-letter size remains a design choice, not a separately verified mandatory size.

font.fallback_behavior: Arial-compliant export requires a lawful existing Arial installation with the required faces. Missing faces prevent compliant export; silent substitution is disabled.

font_size_pt.panel_letter_status: 9 pt bold is a design choice; no independent mandatory panel-letter size was verified.
font_size_pt.mathematical_subscripts: Natural typesetting scale; do not count as standalone body labels.

layout.height_strategy: Reduce excess margins, caption-like notes inside the figure and inter-panel gaps after font migration. Recompute positions; changing font size alone leaves the hardcoded canvas height unchanged.
layout.avoid: Do not uniformly shrink a finished figure or remove intervals to meet a cosmetic height target.
layout.final_height: Choose by legibility and page integration, not a universal hard-coded reduction percentage.
layout.figure5_change: 12 pt additional bottom margin; original data-panel dimensions and fonts retained.

important_existing_code_locations: source/render_figures.py explicit txt(...size) and fontsize calls throughout; changing rcParams alone will not replace hard-coded sizes.
source/render_figures.py hardcoded canvas heights and chart coordinates
source/render_common.py save(): PDF font inspection and SVG text/font-family audit after export

glyphs.minus: U+2212 for negative numeric values and mathematical subtraction
glyphs.numeric_formatter: Use numeric formatting then replace the leading ASCII minus with U+2212; leave compound-word hyphens and filenames intact.
glyphs.subscripts: Render display labels such as R_gate as proper math text or SVG tspan subscripts; preserve machine keys.
glyphs.captions: Convert raw HTML subscript tags through the actual document renderer or replace with supported math markup; do not leave literal tags in final PDF/DOCX.

export_checks: Verify actual embedded PDF font names/families, rather than trusting rcParams.
Inspect all Greek letters, minus signs, hats and subscripts after custom-font mathtext conversion.
Keep SVG editable and all source illustrations vector.
Inspect at 174 mm width and grayscale once after all edits.
Do not copy local font paths, platform user directories or font binaries into publication_patch.
